criteria.requirement: Build cerberus.stream.iter_validated on the delivered validate_result API. Consume one record at a time with independent Validator/schema/options, yield one-based index and independent complete results, and expose continue/stop/raise policies including safe ValidationStreamError. Treat nonmapping DocumentError records as failed results, allow custom validator factories, exact max_records without lookahead, zero consumption and early close. Preserve normal custom exceptions and never materialize the entire input stream or share mutable per-record defaults.
